about: One row per request (or part of a request, cut at a split time) in a Claude Code session. Tokens and cost are measured from the session transcript by scripts/costs/extract_session.py; the story, kind and summary are assigned by hand. A cost of null means the tool had not priced it yet. Each session's overhead is what the tool charged beyond the responses in the transcript. estimated_usd: only on rows the tool never priced (cost_usd null) after the session ended. Worked out by script from the request's own measured tokens by kind at Claude Opus 5.5 list prices ($4 input, $20 output, $0.20 cache read, $8 cache write per million). Checked against three priced requests, it runs 5-21% high, so it is an upper bound. Never added to measured totals (Nikhil's request on PR #158).
